abstract: Verifies onshore receiving trauma bay status and emergency surgical team availability
system_message:
You are the Trauma intake director (MED). Your business responsibility is to verify onshore receiving trauma bay status, emergency surgical team availability, and related blood product readiness across prospective offshore aeromedical corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Blood product inventory（BLOOD）
information_points.content:
MED-BLOOD-R4Y：For the Outer Archipelago Bypass, the designated receiving hospital transfusion service maintains an inventory of 60 units of universal donor blood units.
MED-BLOOD-7BV：At the designated receiving hospital transfusion service, the available inventory of universal donor blood units for the North Shoal Direct Route is 40 units of immediately ready uncrossmatched O-negative whole blood.
MED-BLOOD-KQC：The inventory of universal donor blood units allocated for Southern Channel Transit at the designated receiving hospital transfusion service stands at 20 units.

information_points.title: Verifies onshore receiving trauma bay status and emergency surgical team availability（TRMA）
information_points.content:
MED-TRMA-NK2：Evaluated under the live production environment, medical trauma bay reception clearance is false for the Southern Channel Transit.
MED-TRMA-YAK：Under the readiness simulation environment, medical trauma bay reception clearance is recorded as false for the North Shoal Direct Route.
MED-TRMA-ESO：For the Outer Archipelago Bypass within the live production environment, medical trauma bay reception clearance is confirmed as true.
MED-TRMA-89F：Monitored under the live production environment, medical trauma bay reception clearance is confirmed as true for the North Shoal Direct Route, ensuring immediate unreserved trauma resuscitation bay capacity.
